title: Design System: 天晴动作组工具集管理端

display.purpose: 页面级 h6 标题，如资源包名称

title.purpose: 侧栏、卡片标题、面板标题

shadows.name: app-bar
shadows.purpose: 仅顶栏 elevation-4，分隔导航与内容

motion.name: ease-standard
motion.purpose: Vuetify 默认过渡，状态反馈 150–250ms

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: 主操作：保存、发布、输入密钥
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #1976D2; color: #fff; padding: 8px 16px; font-family: system-ui, 'Microsoft YaHei', 'PingFang SC', sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; border: none; border-radius: 4px; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #1565C0; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #1976D2; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Tonal Button
components.description: 次要操作：重新加载、新建、编辑
components.css: .ds-btn-tonal { background: rgba(25, 118, 210, 0.12); color: #1976D2; padding: 8px 12px; font-family: system-ui, 'Microsoft YaHei', 'PingFang SC', sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; border: none; border-radius: 4px; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.2s; } .ds-btn-tonal:hover { background: rgba(25, 118, 210, 0.18); } .ds-btn-tonal:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #1976D2; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Status Chip
components.description: 全局状态栏：发布预览、检查结果
components.css: .ds-chip-status { display: inline-block; background: rgba(33, 150, 243, 0.12); color: #1976D2; padding: 4px 8px; font-family: system-ui, 'Microsoft YaHei', sans-serif; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 500; border-radius: 4px; }

components.name: Outlined Input
components.css: .ds-field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 4px; font-family: system-ui, 'Microsoft YaHei', sans-serif; } .ds-field-label { font-size: 0.75rem; color: #757575; } .ds-input { padding: 8px 12px; font-size: 0.875rem; border: 1px solid rgba(0,0,0,0.38); border-radius: 4px; background: #fff; transition: border-color 0.2s; } .ds-input:focus { outline: none; border-color: #1976D2; border-width: 2px; padding: 7px 11px; }

components.name: Tonal Alert
components.description: 警告/错误/成功状态提示
components.html: 请先在全局配置中填写 packpath
components.css: .ds-alert { padding: 12px 16px; border-radius: 4px; font-family: system-ui, 'Microsoft YaHei', sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; } .ds-alert-warning { background: rgba(251, 140, 0, 0.12); color: #E65100; }

components.name: Side Nav Item
components.html: 📦天晴安装器
components.css: .ds-nav-item { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 8px 12px; border-radius: 12px; font-family: system-ui, 'Microsoft YaHei', sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; color: #424242; text-decoration: none; transition: background 0.2s; } .ds-nav-item:hover { background: rgba(0,0,0,0.04); } .ds-nav-item-active { background: rgba(25, 118, 210, 0.12); color: #1976D2; font-weight: 500; }

components.name: Data Table Row Selected
components.css: .ds-table-row { font-family: system-ui, 'Microsoft YaHei', sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; } .ds-table-row td { padding: 8px 12px; border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(0,0,0,0.08); } .ds-table-row-selected { background: rgba(25, 118, 210, 0.14); } .ds-table-row-selected:hover { background: rgba(25, 118, 210, 0.2); }

narrative.overview: 面向内网资源浏览与维护的产品界面：公众查阅工具目录，编辑者完成打包发布。在 Vuetify Material 3 之上做克制优化——熟悉、可信、不压迫。动效仅用于状态反馈。
keyCharacteristics: Restrained 配色：蓝色主色仅用于主操作与选中
系统字体：微软雅黑 / 苹方，无 Web 字体
紧凑但不拥挤：compact 管理页 + comfortable 对话框
诚实的状态反馈：tonal alert/chip 直白呈现运维状态
深浅色双主题跟随系统

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: 主色蓝仅用于可点击的主操作与当前导航选中。禁止用主色大面积铺底或装饰性描边。

rules.name: The Semantic-Only Rule
rules.body: success/warning/error/info 只表达状态，不用于品牌装饰。

rules.name: The System Font Rule
rules.body: 禁止引入 Roboto 或其他 Web 字体作为正文字体；保持系统栈。

rules.name: The Density Type Rule
rules.body: 管理表格与侧栏用 compact；对话框表单用 comfortable。

rules.name: The Flat Surface Rule
rules.body: 卡片、表格容器、侧栏默认无 drop shadow。需要分隔时用 border 或 tonal 背景。

rules.name: The No Ghost Card Rule
rules.body: 禁止 1px border 与 box-shadow blur ≥16px 同时出现在同一元素上。

dos: Do 用 variant="tonal" 的 chip/alert 传达状态，保持主内容区留白
Do 危险操作（删除、发布）前用确认对话框
Do 管理页统一 density="compact"，对话框 comfortable
Do 尊重 prefers-reduced-motion，过渡限于 150–250ms 状态反馈
Do 侧栏 + 主工作区 + 可选右侧编辑面板的三栏布局
donts: Don't 做成密密麻麻的企业后台：无层次、无呼吸感的信息墙
Don't 一屏堆满 alert/chip/按钮、缺乏主次
Don't 使用渐变文字、玻璃拟态卡片墙、无意义动效等装饰性 UI
Don't 用 border-left 粗色条作为卡片装饰
Don't 在 inactive 状态使用高饱和主色
Don't 引入 Web 字体导致打包体积膨胀与 preload 泛滥
